title: Auto-resolve grounding-doc conflicts confined to counts line
context: PR #152 proposed dropping the counts sentence from generated docs to avoid a 'doc-ahead' defect (fnd_6391b4242f), but this would lose the helpful 'doc lagging' signal that tripwires the issue when the doc is out of sync with the committed store.
decision: Keep the counts sentence. Implement a specialized git merge driver (merge=hunch-grounding) for the five generated docs that auto-resolves hard conflicts when they are confined solely to the counts line (by keeping 'ours' as a placeholder), while leaving any conflict touching other content untouched for human resolution.
consequences: Preserves the 'doc lagging' signal needed to detect doc/store divergence (self-healed by post-merge hook)
Eliminates manual conflict resolution for append-only counts disagreements (the safe, common case)
Two independent merge drivers now coexist: merge=hunch (JSON records) and merge=hunch-grounding (generated docs)
Merge safety depends on detecting whether a conflict is counts-only; any mistake reverts to human intervention
alternatives_rejected: Drop the counts sentence entirely (would lose the doc-lagging signal that prevents the doc-ahead defect)
Accept all merge conflicts in these docs as requiring manual resolution
Implement a looser merge driver that might auto-resolve real content conflicts and obscure issues
